text:
marta-pm: Quick sync: proposing a 'priority-buckets' degrade plan for surge events. Goal: predictable, auditable degradation with business-hours protection for paying customers. Short sketch below.

lee-eng: Love it. Define buckets (critical | important | normal | best_effort) and map actions per bucket. Lower impact to higher: context trim -> throttle -> quantized model -> cross-region reroute -> best-effort stub.

marta-pm: Exactly. Key differences from previous ideas: 1) explicit business-hour windows per tenant, 2) per-bucket grace thresholds, 3) a visible tenant-state API for support.

anya-sre: Safety rules (proposal): trigger when region_p95 > baseline + 180ms for 90s AND region_gpu_util > 80% for 60s. Rollback/halt if region_error_rate > 1% for 3m. Also cap bucket_evictions_per_min = 10 and global_evictions_per_sec = 5 to avoid cascading.

sam-ops: Flags & knobs (draft):
```
degrade_mode: off | monitor | bucketed
degree_by_bucket: {critical: [trim], important: [trim,throttle], normal: [throttle,downgrade], best_effort: [downgrade,reroute,stub]}
bucket_pct_assignments: {critical: 5, important: 15, normal: 50, best_effort: 30}
bucket_exempt_tenants: [tenant_ids]
business_hours_window: [TZ-aware windows]
bucket_cooldown_s: 900
max_bucket_evictions_per_min: 10
```
Flags should be region-scoped (us-east, eu-west, ap-south).

rachel-sales: Customers will want to map contracts to buckets and buy business-hours protection. We'll add `tenant_tag: business_hours_protected` and surface pricing options. Legal to draft SLA wording for reserved windows.

marta-pm: UX requirement: support view should show current bucket for tenant, last eviction timestamp, and active protections. Also provide an API to toggle `bucket_exempt` and set `business_hours_window`.

anya-sre: Canary plan: shadow-only detection for 24h -> 1% bucketed traffic (15m) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h). For each step: run blind quality checks comparing baseline vs degraded outputs, metric = task_acceptance or similarity score. Halt if quality delta > threshold or customer errors increase. Capture evicted request snapshots for offline evaluation.

sam-ops: Runbook must include: panic endpoint to disable bucketed mode, manual override to route specific tenants to reserved pool, circuit-breaker thresholds, and recovery play (backoff and staged restore). Also add a replay test in CI to simulate surge and validate rate limits.

rachel-sales: I'll draft the customer comms + FAQ about what each bucket means. Include examples for chat, embeddings, and reranking routes.

lee-eng: Launch criteria (MVP):
- API to set bucket assignments + exemptions tested
- Dashboards for p95/p99/error-rate/evictions and per-bucket metrics
- Canary shows <0.5% customer-visible regressions in 48h for critical/important cohorts
- Runbook + panic button published and tested

marta-pm: Next steps: I'll open PRD and flag ticket. Tagging @legal and @sales for pricing + SLA text. Ops/SRE, please validate cooldowns and global caps.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `rollout/priority-buckets/v1` -> canary start 2026-04-10T09:30:00Z (1% traffic, banded)

anya-sre: I'll run traffic-replay sims and propose tuned thresholds. Drop any other must-haves here.
